cards.title: Setup is upload, not generation (ADR-0029; decisions 82, 85, 111)
items: The app never generates or sends the RFI — it uploads the document already sent to the LFI outside this app, auto-parses it, and requires an explicit human confirm before setup finalizes, same "auto-derive, human confirms" pattern as Notice Corpus Manager

Setup fields stay editable after creation (Lead/Approver only) — write-once would force a full re-creation over the most likely failure mode, a wrong SFTP path noticed only once documents fail to appear; edits log as a distinct "setup corrected" audit event

cards.title: Diagram scope
items: Covers only examination creation (decisions 82, 85, 86); the SFTP root's fixed per-license-type folder structure and the Ingestion Adapter's own poll/fetch cycle are drawn in lfi-pipeline-v1.html, not repeated here
Closest standard: a UML sequence diagram — archify's sequence type supports activations/lifelines/return messages natively, so this maps cleanly with no notation gap
